description:
Recently-changed tasks, chronological (not ranked). For "what needs attention?" / "what changed?". Find tasks by content -> memory_search.

Each: preview, progress [done,total], status, topics, collection. Default 32, max 500.
Fan-out: no collection -> personal + all your collections.
Filters: status (active/blocked/review/...), topic, collection.

collection.description: Scope to one collection. Omit=personal + all collections.

limit.description: Max tasks to return. Default 32, max 500.

since.description: ISO timestamp, or 24h / 2d / yesterday. Returns tasks updated after it.

status.description: Omit for every task not done; done lists finished ones.

name: task_feed
